title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the island biogeography research task. Analyzed species-area relationship using power law, exponential, and Gleason models. Found power law model with z=0.272 provided best fit (AIC=-14.2, R²=0.158). Generated comprehensive visualizations and conservation implications: 50% habitat loss leads to 16.4% species loss; preserving 90% of species requires 68.5% of original area. Produced complete research report with methodology, results, figures, and discussion.
